items.body_raw: אָמַר יהוה הֵן הָאָדָם הָיָה כֵּאלֹהִים יֹדֵעַ טוֹב וָרָע וְעַתָּה פֶּן־יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וְלָקַח מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעוֹלָם
items.answer_raw: Yahweh said, Behold, the man is become as God, knowing good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand and take of the tree of life and eat and live for ever.

items.body_raw: And now lest he put forth (send) his hand and take of the tree of life and eat and live for ever.
items.answer_raw: וְעַתָּה פֶּן־יִשְׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְלָקַח מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעוֹלָם

items.body_raw: In those days there-was-not a king in Israel, (every) man did the (thing) upright in his (own) eyes.
items.answer_raw: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה

items.body_raw: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶן אַל־תִּקְרֶאנָה לִי נָעֳמִי קְרֶאןָ לִי מָרָא כִּי הֵמַר שַׁדַּי לִי מְאֹד אֲנִי מְלֵאָה הָלַכְתִּי וְרֵיקָם הֱשִׁיבַנִי יהוה לָמָּה תִקְרֶאנָה לִי נָעֳמִי וַיהוה עָנָה בִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵרַע לִי
items.answer_raw: And she said to them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara, for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me. As for me, I went away full, and Yahweh hath brought me back empty; why do ye call me Naomi, seeing that Yahweh hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath wrought me evil?

items.body_raw: כֹּה אָמַר יהוה לָעֲצָמוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הִנֵּה אֲנִי מֵבִיא בָכֶם רוּחַ וִחְיִיתֶם
items.answer_raw: Thus saith Yahweh to these bones, Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.

items.body_raw: צַוֵּה אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן יהוה וְיַעֲלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן
items.answer_raw: Command the priests that bear the ark of Yahweh that they come up out of the Jordan.

items.body_raw: לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־כָּל־חַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי
items.answer_raw: I will not again smite any more every living thing, as I have done.

items.body_raw: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה
items.answer_raw: The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner.

items.body_raw: וְהָיָה בְּעַנְנִי עָנָן עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְנִרְאֲתָה הַקֶּשֶׁת בֶּעָנָן וְהָיְתָה הַקֶּשֶׁת בֶּעָנָן וּרְאִיתִיהָ לִזְכֹּר בְּרִיתִי
items.answer_raw: And it shall be that when I bring clouds over the earth, then the bow shall be seen in the clouds, and the bow shall be in the clouds, and I will look upon it, to remember my covenant.

items.body_raw: שָׂא נָא עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אִם יוּכַל אִישׁ לִמְנוֹת אֶת־עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ גַּם זַרְעֲךָ יִמָּנֶה
items.answer_raw: Lift up now thine eyes and look; for all the land which thou art looking upon, to thee will I give it; and I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, thy seed also may be numbered.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה לֵךְ מֵעָלָי הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ אַל־תֹּסֶף רְאוֹת פָּנַי כִּי בְּיוֹם רְאֹתְךָ פָּנַי תָּמוּת
items.answer_raw: And Pharaoh said, Depart from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in the day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

items.body_raw: מִי יַשְׁקֵנִי מַיִם
items.answer_raw: O that I had water to drink!

items.body_raw: ואני הנני ממטיר על־הארץ ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה ומחיתי את־כל אשר עשיתי מעל פני האדמה
items.answer_raw: And I, behold, I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will blot out every thing that I have made from off the face of the ground.

items.body_raw: נער הייתי גם־זקנתי ולא ראיתי צדיק נעזב וזרעו מבקש־לחם
items.answer_raw: I have been young and now am old: yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

items.body_raw: Behold, thy maid is in thy (f.) hand, do to her the (thing) good in thine eyes.
items.answer_raw: הִנֵּה שִׁפְחָתֵךְ בְּיָדֵךְ עֲשִׂי־לָהּ הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיִךְ

items.body_raw: And they left off building the city.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּחְדְּלוּ לִבְנֹת הָעִיר

items.body_raw: I am not able to do (any)thing until thou come thither.
items.answer_raw: לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר עַד־בֹּאֲךָ שָׁמָּה

items.body_raw: And the waters increased very (much), and the heads of the mountains were covered.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַמַּיִם מְאֹד וַיְכֻסּוּ רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים

items.body_raw: I have commanded thee not to eat of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, lest thou die.
items.answer_raw: צִוִּיתִיךָ לְבִלְתִּי אֲכָל מִן־הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ הַגָּן פֶּן־תָּמוּת

items.body_raw: For thou, Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel, hast opened the ear of thy servant saying, A house will I build for thee.
items.answer_raw: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ

items.body_raw: And he said unto the children of Israel, (At)-evening (acc.) then (waw. cons. pf.) shall ye know that Yahweh hath brought you out from the land of Egypt, and (in-the)-morning (acc.) then shall ye see his glory.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶרֶב וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי יְהוָה הוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבֹקֶר וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת־כְּבוֹדוֹ

items.body_raw: הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: Walk before me and be perfect, and I will establish my covenant to be thy God.

items.body_raw: And the captain of the host said, Who (ever) shall smite Qiryath Sēpher and take it, then (waw cons.) I will give him my daughter to wife.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׂר הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־בִּתִּי לְאִשָּׁה

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ
items.answer_raw: And when David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives and their sons and their daughters were taken captive.

items.body_raw: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ
items.answer_raw: And he took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into the city of David till he had finished building his house.

items.body_raw: וַיָּקָם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת־צֹאנָם וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל־אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם
items.answer_raw: And Moses arose and came to their rescue and watered their flock: and when they came to their father, he said, Why have you come (so) quickly to-day?

items.body_raw: בְּזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה
items.answer_raw: Thou hast despised me and hast taken the wife of Uriah to be thy wife.

items.body_raw: ועתה לך ואנכי אהיה עם־פיך והוריתיך אשר תדבר
items.answer_raw: And now go, and I, on my part, will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt speak.

items.body_raw: Honour thy father and thy mother, as thy God commanded thee.
items.answer_raw: כַּבֵּד אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ

items.body_raw: They took captive their enemies' wives, and plundered their houses, and then went on their way; but they did not slay (מות, Hiph.) any one.
items.answer_raw: שָׁבוּ אֶת־נְשֵׁי אֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם וְלֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ

items.body_raw: His name shall continually be in my mouth.
items.answer_raw: יִהְיֶה שְׁמוֹ בְּפִי תָמִיד

items.body_raw: יהוה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר
items.answer_raw: Yahweh is my shepherd, I shall not want.

items.body_raw: אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה
items.answer_raw: Every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

items.body_raw: רֹעֶה הָיָה עַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִיו בַּצֹּאן וּבָא הָאֲרִי וְנָשָׂא שֶׂה מֵהָעֵדֶר וְיָצָאתִי אַחֲרָיו וְהִכִּתִיו וְהִצַּלְתִּי מִפִּיו
items.answer_raw: Thy servant was shepherding his father's flock; and if a lion came and took a sheep out of the flock, I would go out after him, and smite him, and rescue it from his mouth.

items.body_raw: זאת הברית אשר אכרת את־בית ישראל אחרי הימים ההם נאם־יהוה נתתי את־תורתי בקרבם ועל־לבם אכתבנה והייתי להם לאלהים והמה יהיו־לי לעם
items.answer_raw: This is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days: I will put my law in their inward parts, and on their hearts will I write it, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

items.body_raw: The more the enemy oppressed them, the more they increased.
items.answer_raw: כַּאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֵּן יִרְבּוּ

items.body_raw: He used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp.
items.answer_raw: יִקַּח אֶת־הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה

items.body_raw: It is not wont to be done so in our land.
items.answer_raw: לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בְּאַרְצֵנוּ

items.body_raw: While he was yet speaking one of his servants came and said, We are undone—all of us.
items.answer_raw: עוֹד הוּא מְדַבֵּר וְאֶחָד מֵעֲבָדָיו בָּא וַיֹּאמַר נִדְמִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ

items.body_raw: אעשה אותך לגוי־עצום ורב ממנו
items.answer_raw: I will make of thee a nation more powerful and numerous than it.

items.body_raw: וַיִּבְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים בְּמַחֲנֵה הָאֹיֵב וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם וַיָּבִאוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם
items.answer_raw: And the three mighty men broke through the enemy's host, and drew water, and brought it to him, but he refused to drink it.

items.body_raw: There were a hundred and twenty-seven cities in his land, and in one of those cities there were a hundred and twenty thousand people.
items.answer_raw: בְּאַרְצוֹ הָיוּ מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע עָרִים וּבְאַחַת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה רִבּוֹת אָדָם

items.body_raw: חָלִילָה לִּי יהוה מֵעֲשֹׂתִי זֹאת הֲדַם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים בְּנַפְשֹׁתָם
items.answer_raw: Far be it from me, O Yahweh, that I should do this thing: (shall I drink) the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?

items.body_raw: O that we had died by the hand of our God in the land of Babylon, when we sat and wept by the waters thereof.
items.answer_raw: מִי־יִתֵּן מוּתֵנוּ בְיַד־יְהוָה בְּאֶרֶץ בָּבֶל בְּשִׁבְתֵּנוּ וּבָכִינוּ עַל־מֵימֶיהָ

items.body_raw: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, in order that thou thyself mayst observe to do according to all that is written therein, and that thou mayst speak of it to thy children after thee, when thou sittest in thine house and when thou walkest by the way.
items.answer_raw: לֹא־יָמוּשׁ סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה מִפִּיךָ וְהָגִיתָ בּוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה לְמַעַן תִּשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכָל־הַכָּתוּב בּוֹ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בּוֹ לְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדָּרֶךְ

items.body_raw: אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי
items.answer_raw: Which I have made

items.body_raw: רָאִיתִי אֶת־הָעִיר
items.answer_raw: I saw the city.

items.body_raw: מָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer_raw: What will the king do?

items.body_raw: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה
items.answer_raw: Answer me, Yahweh.

items.body_raw: לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט
items.answer_raw: To do justice

items.body_raw: וַיִּבְכּוּ הָעָם
items.answer_raw: The people wept.

items.body_raw: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב
items.answer_raw: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good.

items.body_raw: גָּלָה כָבוֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
items.answer_raw: Glory has departed from Israel.

items.body_raw: כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם
items.answer_raw: You have covered all their sin.

items.body_raw: קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: Possessor of heaven and earth

items.body_raw: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה
items.answer_raw: Wait for Yahweh.

items.body_raw: וְהָיוּ לְבָשָׂר אֶחָד
items.answer_raw: And they shall become one flesh.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי כָּל־יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה
items.answer_raw: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי כָל־הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אֶחָת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִים
items.answer_raw: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

items.body_raw: וַיִּהְיוּ חַיֵּי שָׂרָה מֵאָה שָׁנָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי שָׂרָה
items.answer_raw: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah's life.

items.body_raw: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל־פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק־לוֹ
items.answer_raw: Joseph fell on his father's face, wept on him, and kissed him.

items.body_raw: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל־הָהָר וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת־הָהָר
items.answer_raw: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה בְּתוֹךְ הֶעָנָן וַיַּעַל אֶל־הָהָר וַיְהִי מֹשֶׁה בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה
items.answer_raw: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

items.body_raw: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים
items.answer_raw: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

items.body_raw: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
items.answer_raw: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

items.body_raw: וּמִלְחָמָה לֹא הָיָתָה עַד שְׁנַת־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ לְמַלְכוּת אָסָא
items.answer_raw: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign.

items.body_raw: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע בְּרִית בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין כָּל־הָעָם וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהוָה
items.answer_raw: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh's people.

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן לִשְׁתּוֹת עִם־אֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה
items.answer_raw: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

items.body_raw: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא
items.answer_raw: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

items.body_raw: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו
items.answer_raw: Let Yahweh's glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

items.body_raw: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם
items.answer_raw: Blessed be Yahweh's name, from this time forward and forever more.

items.body_raw: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ
items.answer_raw: They have mouths, but they don't speak. They have eyes, but they don't see.

items.body_raw: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

items.body_raw: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ
items.answer_raw: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

items.body_raw: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה
items.answer_raw: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

items.body_raw: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
items.answer_raw: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

items.body_raw: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן
items.answer_raw: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

items.body_raw: מַה־שֶּׁהָיָה הוּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶה וּמַה־שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה הוּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂה וְאֵין כָּל־חָדָשׁ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ
items.answer_raw: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

items.body_raw: יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אֵין טוֹב בָּם כִּי אִם־לִשְׂמוֹחַ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹב בְּחַיָּיו
items.answer_raw: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

items.body_raw: כִּי אִם־עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם הָיוּ מַבְדִּלִים בֵּינֵכֶם לְבֵין אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם הִסְתִּירוּ פָנִים מִכֶּם מִשְּׁמוֹעַ
items.answer_raw: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

items.body_raw: וְשַׁבְתֶּם וּרְאִיתֶם בֵּין צַדִּיק לְרָשָׁע בֵּין עֹבֵד אֱלֹהִים לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא עֲבָדוֹ
items.answer_raw: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn't serve him.
